import re

PHONE_RE = re.compile(
    r"""
    # Exclude if preceded by order/tracking/item context indicators
    (?<!order\s)(?<!order\s\#)(?<!\#)(?<!order\snumber\s)(?<!tracking\s)
    # Optional international prefix
    (?:\+\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?
    # Optional area code with or without parens
    (?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})
    [-.\s]?
    \d{3}
    [-.\s]?
    \d{4}
    # Optional extension
    (?:\s*(?:ext\.?|x)\s*\d+)?,
    re.VERBOSE | re.IGNORECASE
)

# Broader pattern for scanning candidates
PHONE_CANDIDATE = re.compile(
    r"(?:\+\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}(?:\s*(?:ext\.?|x)\s*\d+)?",
    re.IGNORECASE
)

# Negative context words
ORDER_CONTEXT = re.compile(r"(?:order|tracking|item|model|part)\s*(?:#|no\.?|number)?\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)


def find_pii(text):
    spans = []
    for m in PHONE_CANDIDATE.finditer(text):
        start, end = m.span()
        # Check preceding text for order/tracking context
        prefix = text[max(0, start - 25):start]
        if ORDER_CONTEXT.search(prefix):
            continue
        spans.append((start, end, "PHONE"))
    return spans
